title: XOPT v1.0.3: Research Artifact — Code, Data, and Experiments
description: Correction release of XOPT 1.0.2. Preserves all 2668 original attempts, the original computational code and the 24 October 2026 correction records together with the protocol that produced them; adds a separately identified UC correction, fixed-witness radius checks, current numerical witness checks and reconstructed witnesses for the 94 historical single-coordinate interventions, dated 28 October 2026. Internal documents present in versions up to 1.0.2 are excluded. Versions 1.0.1 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23472314) and 1.0.2 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23627564) remain available. Original code is MIT; public data retain their own licenses. Editable manuscript sources are excluded.
